requirements.java: 25 for builds and Minecraft 26.3; Java 17 minimum for the 1.16.1 release runtime
requirements.compiler: C++20; AppleClang on macOS, MinGW GCC on Windows, Zig/GCC on Linux

freetype.macos: host Homebrew FreeType and libpng; not a bit reproducible environment

dependencies.metal: external mcopt 0.3.0-alpha.2 used in macOS QA only; not bundled or independently approved

commands.cross_natives: python3 tools/build_platforms.py windows-x64 linux-x64 linux-arm64 macos-x64

qa_environment.MACLESS_MCOPT: absolute path to the separately installed mcopt JAR for Metal QA
qa_environment.MACLESS_PRISM_LOG: path to a Prism launcher log for the desired local runtime; do not publish account tokens
qa_environment.MACLESS_PRISM_INSTANCE: path to the local Prism instance copied for isolated verification

wayland_capture: xdg-desktop-portal with the desktop matching backend

windows_runtime.capture: Windows 10 version 1903 or newer for Windows Graphics Capture, with compatibility fallback

verification_limits: Byte for byte reproducibility has not been established.
macOS 14 compatibility is unverified because host static dependencies emit macOS 15 deployment warnings.
Windows, Linux and Intel macOS libraries were compiled but full Minecraft sessions on those platforms are unverified.
GitHub Actions results are separate from the existing local QA evidence.
Local QA controllers require a graphical desktop and are absent from release JARs.
